from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from unittest.mock import patch
import json, shutil, sys
from eval.phase05 import verify_frozen as replay

def expect_failure(label, expected):
    from contextlib import redirect_stderr, redirect_stdout
    from io import StringIO
    out = StringIO()
    with patch.object(sys, "argv", ["verify_frozen"]), redirect_stdout(out), redirect_stderr(StringIO()):
        status = replay.main()
    data = json.loads(out.getvalue())
    assert status == 1 and data["outcome"] == "failed" and expected in data["error"], (status, data)
    print(label, "exit", status, data["error"])

with TemporaryDirectory(prefix="testpilot-ci-review-") as temporary:
    receipts = Path(temporary)
    changed = json.loads((replay.RAW / "audit.json").read_bytes())
    changed["sha256"] = "0" * 64
    (receipts / "audit.json").write_text(json.dumps(changed), encoding="utf-8")
    shutil.copyfile(replay.RAW / "small-identity.json", receipts / "small-identity.json")
    with patch.object(replay, "RAW", receipts):
        expect_failure("tampered identity file", "Frozen archive digest differs: audit.json")

original_read = replay.read_json
for label in ("missing null-valued key", "invalid group shape"):
    def changed_read(path):
        data = original_read(path)
        if path.name == "summary.json":
            if label == "missing null-valued key":
                del data["groups"]["A"]["mutation_score"]
            else:
                data["groups"]["C"] = None
        return data
    with patch.object(replay, "read_json", changed_read):
        expect_failure(label, "mutation_score" if label.startswith("missing") else "arm C must be an object")
verified = replay.verify()
assert verified["outcome"] == "passed" and verified["inputs"] == replay.ARCHIVE_SHA256
print("unmodified replay", verified["outcome"], "pinned inputs", sorted(verified["inputs"]))
